references.text: The second census of the descendants of Issachar in the plains of Moab, showing the tribe's growth during the wilderness journey.
Issachar's sons are mentioned when Jacob and his family went to Egypt, showing the origin of the tribe.
The birth of Issachar as a son of Jacob and Leah, the patriarch of this tribe.
The tribe of Issachar and its leader Nethanel during the camp arrangement, supplementing information from the census.
The tribal army of Issachar during the march from Sinai, led by Nethanel son of Zuar.
The genealogy of the descendants of Issachar in Chronicles, showing the further history of the tribe.
